maidstone.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Maidstone and Kent
s1loc: Maidstone runs the events trade of mid-Kent. The Hazlitt Theatre on Earl Street programmes music, comedy and drama through the year, while Mote Park is the county-town stage for big open-air dates, hosting the Maid of Stone rock festival, Rock the Mote and the line of large outdoor shows that began when Radio 1's Big Weekend came to the park. The Maidstone Fringe spreads gigs across pubs and rooms over the May Bank Holiday, keeping a steady live calendar through the summer.

And the trade runs at every size. s1loc: Preston's events trade runs through the Guild Hall, whose 2,000-capacity Grand Hall and 780-seat Charter Theatre have carried live music since Led Zeppelin and David Bowie played there in 1973. s1loc: Walthamstow has built a real live-events scene in east London.
